manifest:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: fugue-api
  namespace: fugue-system
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: fugue-api}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: fugue-api}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: registry.test/api@sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
      volumes:
        - name: node-identity
          downwardAPI:
            items:
              - path: node_name
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.labels['topology.kubernetes.io/hostname']

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: fugue-telemetry-agent
  namespace: fugue-system
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: fugue-telemetry-agent}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: fugue-telemetry-agent}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: telemetry-agent
          image: registry.test/telemetry@sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
      volumes:
        - name: node-identity
          downwardAPI:
            items:
              - path: node_name
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.labels['topology.kubernetes.io/hostname']
name: fugue
